title: Lock
description: Draft 0.2. The lock (decision 0008, ARCHITECTURE section 6). Generated by the kernel's resolver, committed, identical on every platform, replaced atomically. Adding a platform adds entries to platforms and never changes an existing one. Lists are sorted by UTF-8 bytes: entries by kind then name, platforms by os, arch, libc, emulated_on, requires by name. No wall-clock time appears in it. Top-level objects accept extra fields under an x- prefix; nested objects are closed.

upstream.description: The upstream source a digest was verified against.

source.description: Where the tool or provider was obtained from, as a stable designator such as a release address. Never a local path.

published_digest.description: The digest the upstream publishes for what it distributes, with the algorithm named, as upstream states it. The tree digest was verified against it when the lock was generated. A tool whose upstream publishes nothing to compare against is not decided.

name.description: Name of another entry in this lock.

version.description: An exact version: dot-separated non-negative integers.

digest.description: Digest of the canonical listing of the tree for this platform (decision 0008).

entry.description: Entry point: the file to start, relative to the root of the tree. Required for a provider. For a tool, optional: a run description names the program itself.
A provider or tool pinned to an exact version.

version.description: An exact version: dot-separated non-negative integers.

requires.description: The whole requirement closure of this entry, not only its direct requirements: every tool it needs, runtimes included, each pinned by exact version elsewhere in this lock.

platforms.description: One entry per platform the lock covers. A platform with no entry means no build exists there and the obligations needing this entry are unsupported on it.
